title: Volleyball: Bangayan torches Arellano, keeps UE in hunt for semis spot
summary: Van Bangayan was unstoppable as the University of the East overcame Arellano University to stay in the hunt for a Final 4 spot in the 2026 V-League Collegiate Challenge on Saturday.
